query: Which request API aliases share header lookup and how are Referer and Referrer treated?

annotations.answer_rationale: req.get and req.header share header; names are lowercased, and either spelling returns headers.referrer first, then headers.referer.

query: What constraints does res.status enforce before setting statusCode?

annotations.answer_rationale: It requires an integer from 100 through 999; otherwise TypeError or RangeError respectively. It returns the response.

query: How does app.engine register a callback for an extension without a leading dot?

annotations.answer_rationale: It validates the callback is a function, prefixes a dot when needed, and stores it in this.engines[extension].

query: When res.send has a body and a Transfer-Encoding header, does it add Content-Length?

annotations.answer_rationale: No. After determining byte length, it adds Content-Length only when Transfer-Encoding is absent.

query: How does res.jsonp handle an array callback parameter and unsafe callback characters?

annotations.answer_rationale: It selects the first array element, accepts a nonempty string, removes characters outside brackets, word characters, dollar and dot, and emits a guarded JavaScript call.

query: How is a synchronously invoked template-engine callback normalized by View.render?

annotations.answer_rationale: The callback arguments and receiver are copied, then delivered through process.nextTick; callbacks invoked after the engine returns are passed through directly.

query: How does res.clearCookie prevent an options.maxAge from preserving the cookie?

annotations.answer_rationale: It overrides expires with new Date(1), deletes maxAge, and calls cookie with an empty value.

query: How are application behavior and per-application request/response prototypes assembled?

annotations.answer_rationale: createApplication mixes EventEmitter and application methods into a callable app, creates app.request and app.response from the exported prototypes, assigns their app properties, and initializes the app.

query: Where does the application create its router, and which application settings determine its construction?

annotations.answer_rationale: app.init installs a router getter; the first access constructs the external Router with caseSensitive and strict flags read from settings. It reuses that router thereafter.

query: Which prototype and settings inheritance operations run when an application is mounted?

annotations.answer_rationale: onmount optionally removes default trust settings for parent inheritance, then sets request, response, engines and settings prototypes to the parent objects.

query: Trace the query parser setting from app.set to the request query getter.

annotations.answer_rationale: app.set compiles the setting into query parser fn using compileQueryParser; the query getter reads it and invokes it on parseurl query text, or returns a null-prototype empty object when disabled.

query: Trace how a numeric trust proxy setting affects the protocol getter.

annotations.answer_rationale: app.set installs compileTrust(val); numeric trust allows hop indices less than val. protocol tests the socket address at hop 0 before accepting the first trimmed X-Forwarded-Proto value.

query: Trace weak ETag configuration to response body ETag generation.

annotations.answer_rationale: app.set compiles weak into wetag; the generator converts non-Buffers to Buffer and calls etag with weak options. res.send calls etag fn when no ETag is already set and a body length exists.

query: Trace res.render to the source that searches for a view file and an index fallback.

annotations.answer_rationale: res.render calls app.render, which constructs the configured View. View calls lookup, lookup iterates roots and calls resolve; resolve checks dir/file first, then dir/basename(file,ext)/index+ext.

query: How does app.param accept an array of parameter names?

annotations.answer_rationale: It iterates names, recursively registers each with the same callback, then returns the app; single names are delegated to router.param.

query: What does app.all register for a path?

annotations.answer_rationale: It obtains one route, slices callback arguments, and applies those callbacks to each lowercased Node HTTP method on that route.

query: What does req.range return when Range is missing, and how are options forwarded?

annotations.answer_rationale: It returns undefined when no Range header exists; otherwise parseRange(size, range, options) receives the original options.

query: How does req.is normalize variadic type arguments?

annotations.answer_rationale: An array is used directly; other inputs are copied from arguments into an array passed to typeis(this, arr).

query: What request property returns only the parsed pathname of req.url?

annotations.answer_rationale: The path getter returns parse(this).pathname.

query: Which header and comparison determine req.xhr?

annotations.answer_rationale: It reads X-Requested-With, defaults to an empty string, lowercases it, and compares with xmlhttprequest.

query: How does res.attachment choose filename and content type?

annotations.answer_rationale: For a supplied filename it takes basename, derives type from its extension when nonempty, and sets Content-Disposition through contentDisposition.create.

query: How does res.sendStatus choose the body for an unknown but valid HTTP status?

annotations.answer_rationale: It uses statuses.message[statusCode] or String(statusCode), sets status and text type, then sends that body.

query: What does res.type do for an unmapped extension?

annotations.answer_rationale: Without a slash it calls mime.contentType(type), falling back to application/octet-stream; a slash-containing type is passed through to set.

query: How does res.append combine an existing scalar header and a new array value?

annotations.answer_rationale: It concatenates [prev] with the supplied array; existing arrays use prev.concat(val), and two scalars become [prev,val], then set is called.

query: Which response API encodes a redirect location without constructing a response body?

annotations.answer_rationale: res.location sets Location to encodeUrl(url) and returns the response.

query: How does app.path derive the full path for a nested mounted app?

annotations.answer_rationale: It recursively concatenates parent.path() and mountpath; a top-level app returns an empty string.

query: Which application methods write true or false settings and how do enabled/disabled read them?

annotations.answer_rationale: enable and disable call set with true/false; enabled coerces set(setting) to Boolean and disabled negates it.

query: How are Accept type strings with parameters and extension shorthand normalized?

annotations.answer_rationale: normalizeType delegates slash-containing values to acceptParams; extensions use mime.lookup or application/octet-stream with empty params; normalizeTypes maps it over an array.

query: What does setCharset return when type or charset is missing?

annotations.answer_rationale: It returns type unchanged; otherwise it parses the type, overwrites parameters.charset, and formats it.

query: What receiver and arguments does req.acceptsLanguages use when delegating language negotiation?

annotations.answer_rationale: It obtains accepts(this) and calls languages(...languages) on that returned object.

query: How does res.send finish a HEAD response after preparing headers?

annotations.answer_rationale: It calls end() without a chunk for HEAD; other methods pass chunk and encoding.

query: What happens to entity and transfer headers when res.send uses status 204 or 304?

annotations.answer_rationale: Content-Type, Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding are removed and the chunk is set to an empty string.

query: How is a 205 response body handled by res.send?

annotations.answer_rationale: It sets Content-Length to 0, removes Transfer-Encoding and empties the chunk.

query: Does res.send route ArrayBuffer views through res.json?

annotations.answer_rationale: No; ArrayBuffer.isView selects binary handling and sets bin type only when absent; ordinary non-null objects go to json.

query: How does res.links encode several URLs for one relation when a Link header already exists?

annotations.answer_rationale: It preserves the old header with a comma separator, maps each URL to <URL>; rel="relation", and joins entries with commas.

query: Can options.headers override the attachment Content-Disposition generated by res.download?

annotations.answer_rationale: No; the merge skips every key whose lowercase is content-disposition, while copying other keys.

query: How does res.format treat the default property during negotiation and fallback?

annotations.answer_rationale: default is excluded from offered keys; negotiated key runs its callback, otherwise default runs if supplied, else next receives a 406 error with normalized types.

query: How does res.cookie convert millisecond maxAge and object values?

annotations.answer_rationale: Object values receive j: plus JSON.stringify. Numeric maxAge sets expires from Date.now()+maxAge and maxAge to floor(milliseconds/1000); missing path defaults to /.

query: How does req.ips order proxy addresses and remove the socket address?

annotations.answer_rationale: It uses proxyaddr.all with the trust function, reverses the result and pops the socket address.

query: How does req.hostname avoid confusing an IPv6 literal colon with the port separator?

annotations.answer_rationale: For bracket-leading host it starts the colon search after the closing bracket; otherwise it starts at 0, removing only a port suffix.

query: Which X-Forwarded-Host value does req.host choose and when does it ignore that header?

annotations.answer_rationale: Without a header or trust for socket hop 0, Host is used. For a trusted comma list it takes the first value with trimEnd, returning undefined for an empty result.

query: How does req.subdomains handle an IP hostname versus a domain and a custom offset?

annotations.answer_rationale: Missing hostname yields []; IPs become a one-element array, domains are split and reversed, then sliced by subdomain offset.

query: How does acceptParams distinguish quality q from other semicolon parameters?

annotations.answer_rationale: It initializes quality to 1, sets q via parseFloat, and stores other keys in params, skipping malformed separators.

query: How are multiple view roots searched by View.lookup?

annotations.answer_rationale: root is converted to an array; roots are traversed in order until resolve returns a path, then the loop stops.

query: What characters does stringify escape with json escape enabled?

annotations.answer_rationale: For a string result it replaces <, > and & with \u003c, \u003e and \u0026; non-string results are left unchanged.

query: Which locals win when app.render merges application locals, response locals and explicit options?

annotations.answer_rationale: The spread order is this.locals, opts._locals, opts, so explicit options override response locals, which override app locals.

query: Which Node prototypes underlie the Express request and response exports?

annotations.answer_rationale: request exports an object created from http.IncomingMessage.prototype; response exports one from http.ServerResponse.prototype.

annotations.answer_rationale: It imports body-parser and exports its json, raw, text and urlencoded functions; no parser implementations are admitted here.

query: Which references and prototype objects are installed on each dispatched request/response pair?

annotations.answer_rationale: handle sets req.res and res.req, sets their prototypes to this.request/this.response, initializes null-prototype res.locals only if absent, then dispatches.

query: Which per-app dictionaries use null prototypes during initialization and default configuration?

annotations.answer_rationale: cache, engines and settings are initialized with Object.create(null); locals is too and points locals.settings at settings.

query: How does mounted_app restore the parent request/response environment after a child finishes?

annotations.answer_rationale: It remembers req.app, calls child.handle, then sets req and res prototypes to the original app request/response and calls next(err).

query: What cache holds loaded template engine functions and how does View populate it?

annotations.answer_rationale: opts.engines keyed by extension holds engine callbacks; if absent View loads require(mod).__express, validates it and stores it; this.engine references that entry.

query: How does app.render decide whether to reuse or populate the named View cache?

annotations.answer_rationale: It derives renderOptions.cache from the view cache setting only when null; true checks cache[name] and stores successfully resolved new Views there.

query: What server does app.listen create and how does it route the callback on listen errors?

annotations.answer_rationale: http.createServer(this) uses the callable app; a final function argument is wrapped in once and registered on error before server.listen applies arguments.

query: What event-driven state prevents sendfile completion from calling its callback twice?

annotations.answer_rationale: The helper tracks done and streaming; directory/end/error handlers guard done, onfinish schedules a completion or abort decision, and file streams are piped into the response.

query: How is request content negotiation separated from Express wrappers?

annotations.answer_rationale: req.accepts and acceptsEncodings call methods on accepts(this), and charset/language wrappers forward rest arguments; actual negotiation is in external accepts.

query: Which wrapper converts synchronously thrown view.render exceptions into callback errors?

annotations.answer_rationale: tryRender calls view.render in try/catch and calls callback(err) on a thrown error; app.render invokes this wrapper.

query: Trace the callable application function into request dispatch.

query: Trace the default subdomain offset into the request subdomains result.

annotations.answer_rationale: defaultConfiguration sets subdomain offset to 2; subdomains reads it and slices the reversed domain labels or IP array.

query: Trace res.json from serialization settings to its response body.

annotations.answer_rationale: json reads json escape/replacer/spaces, passes them to stringify, sets application/json if needed and sends the serialized body.

query: Trace the configured JSONP parameter name to the callback value.

query: Trace how response headers feed request freshness and alter res.send status.

annotations.answer_rationale: send checks req.fresh; fresh accepts GET, HEAD or QUERY and 2xx/304 statuses, then calls fresh with request headers and response ETag/Last-Modified. A fresh request changes status to 304.

query: Trace req.stale to the predicate deciding HTTP freshness.

annotations.answer_rationale: stale negates fresh; fresh checks method/status before delegating matching to external fresh with response ETag and Last-Modified.

query: Trace req.secure through protocol and the trust proxy compiler.

annotations.answer_rationale: secure compares protocol with https; protocol initially uses socket.encrypted and consults trust at hop 0 before a forwarded header; compileTrust provides the configured trust function.

query: Trace req.subdomains through host and hostname for a port-bearing host header.

query: Trace res.format offered extensions to the selected Content-Type or 406 types list.

annotations.answer_rationale: format negotiates keys with req.accepts, uses normalizeType(key).value on selection and normalizeTypes(keys) for error types; normalization delegates MIME extension lookup or parameter parsing.

query: Trace how res.send changes an existing string Content-Type charset.

annotations.answer_rationale: For a string chunk with string Content-Type, send calls setCharset(type,utf-8), which parses and formats the header, then sets it through res.set.

query: Trace a res.render call without an explicit callback through template rendering back to response completion.

annotations.answer_rationale: res.render supplies a done callback: errors call req.next(err), success calls self.send(str). app.render forwards done through tryRender to view.render, which invokes the engine and normalizes sync completion.

query: Trace response locals from request dispatch through res.render into app.render options.
